result.brief: XGenAct 用统一视频扩散 Transformer 与确定性编解码器，将 RGB、动作、深度、法线和功能分割统一为视频表征，实现跨任务世界动作建模。
result.reason: World action model predicting future observations/actions with unified video diffusion transformer and deterministic codecs for depth, normals, segmentation; robot manipulation focus but core is world modeling representation.
